description:
World Fastest Car🔥

2022 Bugatti Chiron Super Sport 300+. 1 of 30 only made of this record-breaking Bugatti with a top speed of 490.484 KM/H

The fastest production hyper sports car ever finished in Jet Black in Fully Exposed Carbon Fiber

- 8.0L W16 Quad-Turbocharged Engine
- 7-Speed Automatic Transmission
- 1,600 Horsepower
- 1,600 N.M of Torque
- All Wheel Drive
- 0 to 100 KM/H approximately 2.4 s
- Top Speed 490,484 KM/H

Extras:
1 of 30 units only made

The Bugatti Chiron Super Sport 300+ is officially the first-ever production-based car to break 300 mph

- Exterior - Fully Exposed Black Carbon with Racing Stripes in Jet Orange
- Wheels - Ultra-Lightweight Magnesium Wheels finished in Nocturne Paint
- Special Edition Bugatti Macaron made from Genuine Silver and Black Enamel
- A Modified and Unique Exhaust Tailpipes 
- Interior - Finished in Black Carbon, Leather, and Alcantara in Beluga Black with eye-catching Jet-Orange contrasting.
- Extended Bodywork (Long-Tail)
- ‘C’ Style LED Light
- “Super Sport 300+” welcome lights
- Engine Bay finished in Exposed Carbon Fibre (Black)
- Windscreen Viper finished in Exposed Carbon Fibre (Black)
- Accuton Premium Sound System (High-Performance - High-End Sound System by Bugatti)
